sentences.text:
Gajendra Pratap Singh Alias Gajadhar vs National Highway
Authrotiy Of India

Bench: Suneet Kumar, Rajendra Kumar-Iv
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 42
Case :- Writ - C No. - 10478 of 2023
Petitioner :- Gajendra Pratap Singh Alias Gajadhar

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Respondent :- National Highway Authrotiy Of India And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashish Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Akanksha Gaur,Chandan Agarwal Hon'ble Suneet Kumar,J.
Hon'ble Rajendra Kumar-IV,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Petitioner by the instant petition seeks the following relief:
"(a) issue an appropriate writ, order or direction to the respondent no. 2 to pay compensation to the petitioner as per his share in the land i.e. arazi no. 242 area 1.06 (hec) situate at Mauza-Shivpur, Pargana-Majhwar, Tehsil and District Chandauli under acquisition as per notification dated 24.11.2022 (Annexure No......) u/s 3(4) of the National Highways Authority Act 1956."
It is submitted by learned Standing Counsel that the second respondent shall consider the representation/objection of the petitioner.
